title: Malmö, Skåne — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Malmö, Skåne: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Malmö is a city in Skåne with a population of 316,000. A multicultural city connected to Copenhagen by the Øresund Bridge, known for its modern architecture and parks. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
